policy: A wave with no trigger in the owner data: wave 1 starts when the content starts, each later wave starts when the wave before it is cleared (every NPC of it killed). A trigger the owner data gives is used as it is unless a rule below replaces it. A rule names its own source; the owner data is family-derived for most dungeons and is not a CCP source.

dungeons.name: Breeding Facility
dungeons.note: The wiki gives a timer of 4 minutes for the first wave; the owner data has it on load. The compositions differ (the wiki lists transports and battleships, the owner data a deadspace pool); only the trigger is taken from the wiki.
